solution_steps: Use Multiplication of Ants to exchange him for two Army Ant Tokens and an Arsenal Bug, all in attack mode.
Run Mystic Tomato into Gemini Elf to summon Cannon Soldier from your deck.
Attack the elf with your Arsenal bug, then attack directly with the other monsters.
Finally tribute all your monsters as fodder for Cannon Soldier (finally, himself). Game!
